data.title: Prive
data.about:
Welcome to the most beautiful views of the Dubai Canal. Only at Prive by Damac. An exclusive collection of apartments with a range of studios, 1, and 2 bedroom options. This tower is located within Business Bay in Dubai, which is a perfect blend of the urban upscale mix-use residential community and commercial sector. Home to the best leisure and entertainment options, Business Bay also offers its residents green spaces with a famous boulevard, the largest shopping mall in the world and the iconic dancing fountains, all just minutes away from Burj Khalifa.

Residents of Prive will not just have access to the panoramic views of the Canal, they will also have a temperature-controlled swimming pool, health club, spa, children’s play area, and manicured landscaping. Prive is located just minutes from Jumeirah beach, DIFC, Dubai World Trade Centre and the Dubai International Airport. Choose Prive to wake up to the best views of Dubai.

seo.metaTitle: Prive by Damac - Luxury Apartments with Canal Views
seo.metaDescription: Prive by Damac in Business Bay offers exclusive studios & 1-2 BR apartments with Dubai Canal views, close to Burj Khalifa & world-class amenities.
